assumptions_and_limits: Reuse is intentional: this is the existing aim-unit host input path, not reconstruction of the original 006082D0 plane-HUD receiver.
Both inputs come from live state. The existing target-height policy and fixed-pitch input remain host policies; no lead scale, divisor, task receiver or world value was manufactured.

The body normalizes both vectors and applies native-style finite/wrap behavior instead of the old hand-written double angle math. Host steering subtracts both outputs because the body's pitch error is negated.

Execution is conditional on the existing aim-unit input, a ready camera, a live visible target and the existing horizontal-range guard. Static entry reach and synthetic numeric checks do not prove an in-game tracking run or original binary ABI compatibility.
